answer: Each guarantor stakes 100 POA and signs vouches with a quill key whose capacity halves per vouch: 100, 50, 25... so one sponsor backs about seven accounts before a vouch is worth under 1 POA. To forge 1,000 sybils an attacker needs roughly 143 independent guarantors, each with fresh locked stake. Vouch chains are traced like a vine; if one branch is caught in a duplicate-answer audit, every guarantor up that vine is slashed. Colluders cannot pool capacity since halving is per key. An honest user needs just one vouch.
